rv.q: Granted, her debut play, The Hungry Ghost , sounds like it could have been penned by Dahl, but also like him, the surface of what she’s presenting hides a surprising level of depth, nuance and social commentary. Girl ( Mei Mac ) is about to sneak out of the family home as she starts the secret process of moving in with her girlfriend.

Mei Mac is terrific as the Girl born in the UK to Chinese immigrant parents. A trainee solicitor, Mac’s character wants to visit – and live with – her girlfriend Naomi, but it’s the month of the Hungry Ghost and her superstitious mother is anxious.
The Ghost's departure from Girl leaves a sense of a story well rounded and well told, though a little more time with the Ghost's life before she became a ghost might have been even more satisfying.
